text: RBI Raises UPI Lite Offline Transaction Cap to Rs 1,000. The Reserve Bank of India raised the per-transaction limit for UPI Lite offline wallets to Rs 1,000 and total wallet balance to Rs 5,000 to accelerate low-value retail payments in semi-urban corridors without PIN friction. (Mint dispatch).

(Economic Times dispatch).

ISRO Completes 200-Second Cryogenic Engine Hot Test at Mahendragiri. The Indian Space Research Organisation successfully conducted a 200-second flight-acceptance hot test of the upgraded CE-20 cryogenic engine at its Mahendragiri propulsion complex in Tamil Nadu. Engineers verified throttle modulation and chamber pressure stability ahead of upcoming Gaganyaan and heavy-lift LVM3 commercial missions. (The Hindu dispatch).
